d: A mutated humanoid species with matted, moss-green hair and an amorphous, distorted body. Pale yellow eyes wide with a manic, unstable expression. Appears as a distorted adult with a decaying, organic maturity. Lanky, asymmetrical build covered in slime and fungal growths. No standard outfit, as the body is encased in a translucent, sickly green organic mass. Signature details include long, clawed fingers and a thick, dripping slime-covered tail. BODY COLOR: moss-green
